title: Space Defender
description: A space shooter where you defend Earth from alien invaders.
rules: Shoot all aliens before they reach the bottom. You have 3 lives.
goals: Survive all waves and achieve the highest score.
controls: Arrow keys to move, Space to shoot
enemies: Green aliens that move in formation and occasionally dive-bomb.
player: A blue spaceship at the bottom of the screen
rewards: 100 points per alien, 500 points per wave cleared
